Parts.Description: Dark diamond-plate steel with gold edging, a gold coin medallion and a polished marble yard.
Parts.Name: Vault Floor

Parts.Description: A thick steel strongroom with a roof of vents and a gold VAULT sign above the open doorway.
Parts.Name: Vault Chamber

Parts.Description: A huge round steel door with a gold turning wheel, set in a heavy frame with hinges and bolts.
Parts.Name: Round Vault Door

Parts.Description: A marble and gold arch behind the Gold Shiba with a shining halo, so everyone knows who owns the vault.
Parts.Name: Golden Halo Arch

Parts.Description: Three pyramids of shiny gold bars, stacked high and not a single one missing.
Parts.Name: Gold Bar Stacks

Parts.Description: A glittering mountain of gold coins with a few loose towers of coins around it.
Parts.Name: Coin Mountain

Parts.Description: Three security gates with red laser beams across the floor. Do not touch!
Parts.Name: Laser Gates

Parts.Description: A heavy armoured truck with a gold stripe and a gold back door, parked to unload.
Parts.Name: Armoured Truck

Parts.Description: A guard desk with a glass screen, three monitors and a chair for the night watch.
Parts.Name: Guard Desk

Parts.Description: A golden Shiba statue on a marble plinth with a ruby collar. Its tail wags in the sun.
Parts.Name: Gold Shiba Statue

Parts.Description: The royal crown on a velvet cushion inside a glass case, behind two gold rope posts.
Parts.Name: Crown Jewels Case

Parts.Description: A trolley piled with bundles of cash and a gold bar on top.
Parts.Name: Money Trolley

Parts.Description: A huge sparkling diamond on a marble pedestal.
Parts.Name: Giant Diamond

Parts.Description: A giant combination safe with a gold dial and spoked wheel, big enough to hide a whole Shiba.
Parts.Name: Giant Safe

Parts.Description: A big stamping press that mints gold coins and drops them onto a conveyor belt.
Parts.Name: Coin Mint Press

Parts.Description: Three cameras on tall poles, watching the path and the gold at all times.
Parts.Name: Security Cameras

Parts.Description: Three tall gold lamps with cream shades that make the whole vault glow warm.
Parts.Name: Gold Floor Lamps

Parts.Description: A giant golden piggy bank with a coin on its way into the slot. Every hit makes it jingle.
Parts.Name: Golden Piggy Bank

Parts.Description: Three wooden treasure chests with gold bands, overflowing with coins, inside the strongroom.
Parts.Name: Treasure Chests

Parts.Description: A giant golden balance scale. The gold side is much heavier than the feather side.
Parts.Name: Giant Gold Scale

Parts.Description: A little orange forklift carrying a pallet piled high with gold bars.
Parts.Name: Gold Forklift

Parts.Description: A marble fountain with gold bowls and a big coin on top, spraying sparkling water.
Parts.Name: Gold Coin Fountain

Parts.Description: Three glass display cases on a red carpet, each with a big jewel inside.
Parts.Name: Jewel Display Cases

Parts.Description: A tall golden throne on a marble dais with a red carpet leading up to it.
Parts.Name: Golden Throne

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a giant gold coin with a dollar sign, standing in a steel cradle with a ruby on top.
Parts.Name: Mega Gold Coin
